mapper.select: SELECT mv.YEAR, mv.MONTH, mv.FACTORY_CODE, mv.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE, mv.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, mv.CREATE_TIME FROM t_mp_proc_version mv WHERE mv.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mv.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND mv.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND IFNULL(mv.PLAN_TYPE, '00') = '01' AND IFNULL(mv.IS_SELECTED_DEMAND, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(mv.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_mp_proc_version pv WHERE pv.FACTORY_CODE = mv.FACTORY_CODE AND pv.YEAR = mv.YEAR AND pv.MONTH = mv.MONTH AND pv.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = mv.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION AND IFNULL(pv.PLAN_TYPE, '00') = '01' AND IFNULL(pv.IS_SELECTED_DEMAND, 0) = 1 AND IFNULL(pv.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 ) ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
